links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of chatbot and physician responses to patient cancer questions
links.effect: Mean FK grade: physicians 10.11; chatbot 3 10.31 (P>.99); chatbot 1 12.33 (P<.001); chatbot 2 11.32 (P=.01). All above plain-language levels.
links.quote: The mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of physician responses (mean, 10.11 [95% CI, 9.21-11.03]) was not significantly different from chatbot 3 responses (mean, 10.31 [95% CI, 9.89-10.72]; P > .99) but was lower than those from chatbot 1 (mean, 12.33 [95% CI, 11.84-12.83]; P < .001) and chatbot 2 (mean, 11.32 [95% CI, 11.05-11.79]; P = .01).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM chatbot responses to Reddit cancer questions compared to physician responses for quality, empathy, and readability without testing a specific deployment safeguard or workflow intervention.
